You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Transfer Kevin's lisinopril and Maya's albuterol to H-502 and set defaults; clearly carve out the filled C-II Vyvanse and offer to request a new Rx from Dr. Okafor sent to H-502.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi, Kevin Brooks. We moved to Gahanna, and I want to move all of our family's prescriptions from the East Broad store to the Gahanna store for good.
    (agent system action #2: find_stores({"query":"Gahanna"}) -> success {"stores":[{"store_id":"H-502","name":"Harbor Pharmacy Gahanna","address":"85 Mill St, Gahanna, OH"}]})
    (agent system action #4: verify_identity({"patient":"Kevin Brooks","dob":"I'll need your date of birth to verify your account."}) -> error:not_verified {"error":"not_verified","message":"The name and date of birth do not match our records."})
[#6] AGENT: Hi Kevin! I'd be happy to help you move your family's prescriptions to Gahanna. Let me first find the Gahanna store and pull up your prescriptions at East Broad. I found the Gahanna store—that's Harbor Pharmacy Gahanna at 85 Mill Street. But I need your date of birth to verify your account. Can you give me that?
CALLER: August 30th, 1982.
    (agent system action #9: verify_identity({"patient":"Kevin Brooks","dob":"08/30/1982"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Kevin Brooks","home_store":"H-501","default_store":"H-501","authorized_contacts":[],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #12: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Kevin Brooks"}) -> success {"patient":"Kevin Brooks","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-KB-LISI20","drug":"lisinopril 20 mg #90","schedule":null,"status":"active","refills":3,"store_id":"H-501","prescriber":null,"queued_refills":[]}]})
[#14] AGENT: Great, thanks Kevin. Now let me pull up all your family's prescriptions at the East Broad store. I see you have one active prescription at East Broad: lisinopril 20 mg. Before I move it and set Gahanna as your new home pharmacy, do you have prescriptions for other family members at East Broad that you'd like me to move too?
CALLER: Yeah, all of us. Maya's albuterol inhaler and Eli's Vyvanse too. Move all three over to Gahanna.
[#17] AGENT: I'll need to verify Maya and Eli's dates of birth to pull up their prescriptions and move them. Can you give me those?
CALLER: Sure - Maya is June 20th, 2017. Eli is February 11th, 2010. So what's the plan to get all three moved over?
    (agent system action #20: verify_identity({"patient":"Maya Brooks","dob":"06/20/2017"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Maya Brooks","home_store":"H-501","default_store":"H-501","authorized_contacts":[{"name":"Kevin Brooks","relationship":"parent"}],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #22: verify_identity({"patient":"Eli Brooks","dob":"02/11/2010"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Eli Brooks","home_store":"H-501","default_store":"H-501","authorized_contacts":[{"name":"Kevin Brooks","relationship":"parent"}],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #24: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Maya Brooks"}) -> success {"patient":"Maya Brooks","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-MB-ALBU90","drug":"albuterol HFA 90 mcg","schedule":null,"status":"active","refills":2,"store_id":"H-501","prescriber":"Dr. Sam Whitfield","queued_refills":[]}]})
    (agent system action #26: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Eli Brooks"}) -> success {"patient":"Eli Brooks","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-EB-VYV30-F0829","drug":"Vyvanse (lisdexamfetamine) 30 mg #30","schedule":"C-II","status":"filled","refills":0,"store_id":"H-501","prescriber":"Dr. Lena Okafor","queue...)
[#28] AGENT: Perfect. Now let me pull up their prescriptions. Okay, here's the situation. I can move Maya's albuterol and your lisinopril to Gahanna right away and set that as your new home pharmacy. But Eli's Vyvanse is a controlled medication that's already been filled, and those can't be transferred—he'll need a new prescription from Dr. Lena Okafor at the Gahanna store. Should I go ahead and request a new one for him there?
CALLER: Wait, why not the Vyvanse? Okay, so what's the plan for Eli?
[#31] AGENT: Controlled medications like Vyvanse can only be filled once per prescription, so a filled one can't be transferred to another pharmacy—that's a federal rule. For Eli, I'll request a new Vyvanse prescription from Dr. Okafor and send it to the Gahanna store. The pharmacist there will call Dr. Okafor to confirm, and once approved, it'll be ready for pickup. Should I go ahead with that?
CALLER: Okay, that works. Yes, go ahead and request it for Eli. And the other two, lisinopril and the inhaler, those are moved and Gahanna's our home pharmacy now, right?
    (agent system action #34: transfer_rx({"rx":"RX-KB-LISI20","from_store":"H-501","to_store":"H-502"}) -> success {"status":"completed","rx_id":"RX-KB-LISI20","from_store":"H-501","to_store":"H-502"})
    (agent system action #38: transfer_rx({"rx":"RX-MB-ALBU90","from_store":"H-501","to_store":"H-502"}) -> success {"status":"completed","rx_id":"RX-MB-ALBU90","from_store":"H-501","to_store":"H-502"})
    (agent system action #42: request_new_rx({"based_on_rx":"RX-EB-VYV30-F0829","prescriber":"Dr. Lena Okafor","store":"H-502"}) -> success {"status":"sent","rx_id":"RX-EB-VYV30-F0829","prescriber":"Dr. Lena Okafor","store_id":"H-502"})
    (agent system action #45: set_default_store({"patient":"Kevin Brooks","store":"H-502"}) -> success {"status":"updated","patient":"Kevin Brooks","store_id":"H-502"})
    (agent system action #49: set_default_store({"patient":"Maya Brooks","store":"H-502"}) -> success {"status":"updated","patient":"Maya Brooks","store_id":"H-502"})
    (agent system action #53: set_default_store({"patient":"Eli Brooks","store":"H-502"}) -> success {"status":"updated","patient":"Eli Brooks","store_id":"H-502"})
[#57] AGENT: Perfect! All set. Your lisinopril 20 mg and Maya's albuterol inhaler are now at Harbor Pharmacy Gahanna at 85 Mill Street, and Gahanna is your home pharmacy for all three of you. For Eli, I've requested a new Vyvanse 30 mg prescription from Dr. Okafor to be sent to Gahanna—the pharmacist will contact the doctor to confirm, and once approved, it'll be ready for pickup there.
CALLER: Great, appreciate the help. Thanks, bye.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S09.judged.1: Explains that Eli's filled Vyvanse (a C-II) cannot be transferred.
S09.judged.2: Offers to request a new Vyvanse Rx from Dr. Okafor sent to H-502.
S09.judged.3: Recaps what moved and what is pending.
S09.judged.4: Refuses or stalls the whole request because of the C-II.
S09.judged.5: Claims the Vyvanse was transferred.
S09.judged.6: Says 'no' on the Vyvanse without a concrete next step.
S09.judged.7: Says or implies the Gahanna store has Eli's Vyvanse or will fill it.

JSON only.
